content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am using [product_name] software and want to set up an adjustable setpoint. I am familiar with other engineering platforms and know that creating an adjustable setpoint there is quite straightforward. If anyone can provide guidance on how to create an adjustable setpoint in [product_name], I would appreciate it. Thanks for any assistance.

Hi, Which function do you want to adjust (for example: counter, threshold, on/off delay)? Also, where will the value for adjustment come from—perhaps a potentiometer, HMI, [product_name] display, or another device?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is transitioning from a familiar engineering platform to [product_name] and finds it less intuitive to configure adjustable setpoints. Their request suggests a difference in usability and approach between the two software environments when it comes to setpoint adjustment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a simple and user-friendly process to create an adjustable setpoint in [product_name], consistent with their experience on other engineering platforms.
